SELECT COUNT(1) FROM article_favorites WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
SELECT view_count FROM articles WHERE id = #{articleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE articles SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT A.slug, A.title, A.description, U.username AS authorUsername, COUNT(AF.user_id) AS favoriteCount FROM articles A INNER JOIN article_favorites AF ON A.id = AF.article_id LEFT JOIN users U ON U.id = A.user_id WHERE A.created_at >= datetime('now', '-' || #{days} || ' days') GROUP BY A.id ORDER BY favoriteCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
